latest_release.name: .NET 10.0.15
latest_release.body:
[Release](https://github.com/dotnet/core/releases/tag/v10.0.15)

## What's Changed
* [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet by @dotnet-maestro[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/69430
* [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet by @dotnet-maestro[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/69446
* [release/10.0] (deps): Bump src/submodules/MessagePack-CSharp from `365965f` to `be938cd` by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/69541
* [release/10.0] (deps): Bump src/submodules/googletest from `8eff9e3` to `4267679` by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/69540
* [release/10.0] Update npm dependencies by @wtgodbe in https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/69615
* [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet by @dotnet-maestro[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/69648
* [release/10.0] Quarantine flaky HttpSys delegation test by @wtgodbe in https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/69715
* [release/10.0] fix PinnedBlockMemoryPoolFactory DI dependency on TimeProvider by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/69722
* [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet by @dotnet-maestro[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/69679
* [release/10.0] Honor custom policies allowing output caching for authenticated users by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/69725
* [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet by @dotnet-maestro[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/69745
* [release/10.0] Update Handlebars to 4.7.10 by @wtgodbe in https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/69776
* [release/10.0] (deps): Bump src/submodules/googletest from `4267679` to `b66cffc` by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/69813
* [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet by @dotnet-maestro[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/69783
* [release/10.0] Fix empty PathBase on first IIS in-process request after startup by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/69712
* [release/10.0] Update OpenApi to 2.13.0 by @Youssef1313 in https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/69940
* [release/10.0] Fix ResponseCompression tests to work with different zlib implementations (#63988) by @omajid in https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/69806


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/compare/v10.0.13...v10.0.15
